sloka: ततः पद्मादिभिस्तत्र निधिभिः स तदा वृतः ।धनदोच्छ्वासितस्तैस्तु वनमानीय नन्दनम् ।। ७.१५.३७ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ padmādibhistatra nidhibhiḥ sa tadā vṛtaḥ ।dhanadocchvāsitastaistu vanamānīya nandanam ।। 7.15.37 ॥

translations.english: Then, surrounded by the treasures like Padma and others, Kubera was revived by them and brought to the Nandana forest.
